purpose: Define PGP-based protection for session-key exchange or protected DWH/message payload envelopes while keeping cryptographic keys separate from identity, authority and domain semantics.

topics.name: PGP Session Protection
topics.purpose: Define PGP-based protection for session-key exchange or protected DWH/message payload envelopes while keeping cryptographic keys separate from identity, authority and domain semantics.

semantics.session_key_rule: Session keys are generated/negotiated per explicit transport/security lifecycle.
semantics.pgp_rule: PGP protects the session key and/or payload envelope according to the owning transport profile.
semantics.identity_rule: Cryptographic key identity/fingerprint may bind to an identity through explicit trust configuration but is not automatically the semantic identity itself.
semantics.rotation_rule: Session keys are bounded and rotated/replaced according to explicit lifecycle policy.
semantics.secret_rule: Private keys/session secrets are never emitted into ordinary canonical data, logs or projections.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful cryptographic verification proves the declared cryptographic property only; it does not grant application authority.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: private/session key exposed in ordinary logs
successful crypto verification grants application authorization
key fingerprint used as semantic identity without explicit binding
session key lifetime unbounded without policy

references.purpose: DWH envelope may use PGP/session-key protection.

prose.summary: Define PGP-based protection for session-key exchange or protected DWH/message payload envelopes while keeping cryptographic keys separate from identity, authority and domain semantics.
